children: Medtronic reported first-quarter fiscal 2027 results with revenue of $9.756 billion, up 13.7% year-over-year, and non-GAAP diluted EPS of $1.45. GAAP diluted EPS was $1.14 and GAAP net income attributable to Medtronic totaled $1.470 billion for the quarter. The company raised its FY27 organic revenue growth guidance to 7.25%–7.75% and increased diluted non‑GAAP EPS guidance to $5.94–$6.00.
Revenue: $9.756 billion for Q1 FY27, up 13.7% as reported and 13.7% organic versus prior year.
Gross profit and margin: GAAP gross margin 65.0% (as reported in reconciliations).
Operating income: GAAP operating profit $1.764 billion; GAAP operating margin 18.1%.
Net income: GAAP net income attributable to Medtronic $1.470 billion for the quarter.
Adjusted (non-GAAP) diluted EPS: $1.45 for Q1 FY27; company raised FY27 diluted non-GAAP EPS guidance to $5.94–$6.00.
Cardiovascular portfolio led growth with $3.927 billion in revenue, up 19.5% reported and 18.9% organic; strong gains in Electrophysiology Therapies and Cardiac Rhythm Management.
Neuroscience portfolio revenue $2.678 billion, up 10.3% reported and 9.3% organic; Cranial & Spinal Technologies and Pelvic Health (Altaviva) contributed notably.
Medical Surgical revenue $2.279 billion, up ~10% reported and 10.2% organic, driven by Surgical & Endoscopy and Acute Care & Monitoring growth.
Diabetes business reported $843 million in revenue, up 16.9% reported and 14.9% organic; separation of the Diabetes business remains in process through capital markets transactions.

Key operational milestones: expanded CE Mark indication for Affera Mapping and Ablation System and Sphere-9 Catheter; strategic investments and partnerships including Pi-Cardia and Cornerstone Robotics; completed acquisitions of Scientia Vascular and SPR Therapeutics; received FDA clearance for Touch Surgery Aide next-generation platform.
